==Description==
'''Ruby Escort''' is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place on a large red island with multiple rubies scattered across it.

==Design & Path==
'''Ruby Escort''' takes place on a grassy island in the middle of the ocean. The terrain of the map is mainly mountainous, though there are two small plains with small cliffs. The grass on this map is red. There are multiple trees and bushes around the map, with their leaves being red. Multiple lamp posts, rocks and rubies can be seen scattered across the map. There are two large wooden gates near the path. There is also a giant wooden ship with a black sail docked near the island, that has multiple wooden crates and lamps being placed on it.

The path starts and ends at a cave. The path goes through the ship and under the two gates on the map.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*It is recommended to place your towers either on the ship or at the back, as these spots cover most of the map's path.
**Do note that the space on the ship is very limited, meaning you cannot place many towers there.
**The turns on the ships may be useful for towers with short range such as the [[Shotgunner]].
***Though it may not be recommended as it is quite far from the entrance.
*The path is quite long so cliff towers or towers with long range may help in this map.
